breakdown.description: The water column is oriented vertically along the y-axis, but the gravity vector in `constant/g` is incorrectly pointing in the negative z-direction. For the water to collapse downwards, gravity must be set to `(0 -9.81 0)`.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly changed the gravity vector from the incorrect `(0 0 -9.81)` to `(0 -9.81 0)`. This aligns with the ground truth, as the 2D simulation is in the x-y plane and requires gravity to act in the negative y-direction for the dam break to work as intended.
